Then one day at work I brought up this topic with the guys, how they handle this. They suggested hiring a girl, but honestly I don't want to throw that much money away, and the feeling isn't the same, no real passion, like you hop on and watch the clock for how much time is left. So I dropped that option. I didn't dare right away, but about a week later when the wife turned me down again, I kinda snapped and signed up there <LINK>, put up a couple decent pics, wrote straight in my profile that I'm looking for young and hot for intimate stuff, set the filter to 20 km and age up to 25, and started liking everyone.

Parents are out of town, or I can come to you, just let's make it quick."

At first I thought it was a prank. But no, she even sent the address and a pic of the place.

She came like five times, honest. In the morning she made coffee and said: "Come again, you're awesome."

Now I drop by a couple times a week. Sometimes I chat with a few others too, swing by once or twice for variety, but mostly I go to her. Feels like I'm 25 again lol
